compress.title: Compress conversation history
compress.description: The current chat model writes a structured summary of the conversation so far and adds it at the end.
compress.additional_prompt_hint: What to keep or focus on
compress.keep_recent_desc: These messages are not compressed and stay after the summary. 0 compresses everything and reuses the prompt cache best; if the conversation is too long to compress, keep more messages.
compress.background_hint: Compression runs on the phone in the background and continues if you close this page. Messages sent meanwhile are queued and sent when it finishes.
compress.running_from_app: The app is compressing this conversation's history…
compress.running_hint: Messages sent meanwhile are queued and sent when it finishes; regenerate is unavailable until then.
compress.wait: Compressing history. Try again when it finishes.
compress.error_busy: The conversation is generating, waiting for approval or has queued messages. Try compressing later.
compress.error_already: This conversation is already being compressed
compress.error_changed: The conversation changed during compression; nothing was saved. Please retry.
compress.checkpoint_info: It uses the same request as the chat, so the prompt cache is reused. Earlier messages stay visible but are no longer sent to the model; delete the summary to undo.
compress.error_nothing: No new messages to compress since the last summary
compress.error_not_enough: Not enough messages to compress. Reduce the number of messages to keep.
compress.error_pending_tools: Handle the pending tool calls before compressing
compress.error_tool_call: The model tried to call a tool instead of writing the summary. Please try again.
